title: St. Xavier's College, Kolkata
description: St. Xavier's College is a prestigious college in Kolkata offering undergraduate and postgraduate courses in Arts, Science, and Commerce.
address: 30 Mother Teresa Sarani, Kolkata, West Bengal 700016

admission.admissionProcess: Admissions are purely merit-based on previous qualifying exam scores. Some courses may require a written entrance test.

aiReviewSummary: A highly reputed institution known for its strict discipline, excellent faculty, and vibrant campus life. The alumni network is one of the strongest in the country.

title: Dinhata College
description: Dinhata College, established in 1956, is a prominent higher education institution situated in the sub-divisional town of Dinhata, Cooch Behar, West Bengal. Affiliated with the Cooch Behar Panchanan Barma University and recognized by the UGC, the college has been a beacon of learning for students in the region for decades.The institution offers a diverse range of undergraduate programs in Arts, Science, and Commerce. With a dedicated faculty, well-equipped laboratories, and a rich central library, Dinhata College is committed to fostering academic excellence and empowering the youth through inclusive and quality education.
address: Dinhata College Road, Ward No 7, Dinhata, Cooch Behar, West Bengal, 736135

seo.seoTitle: Dinhata College | Admission, Courses, Fees & Details
seo.seoDescription: Explore Dinhata College in Cooch Behar. Discover BA, BSc, BCom courses, admission details, fee structures, and campus facilities at this UGC recognized college.

courses.title: B.A. (Honours) Bengali
courses.eligibility: 10+2 with 50% in aggregate and 55% in Bengali

courses.title: B.Sc. (Honours) Mathematics
courses.eligibility: 10+2 with Science and minimum 55% in Mathematics

courses.title: B.Com. (General)
courses.eligibility: 10+2 passing marks from any recognized board

placement.placementDescription: The placement and career counseling cell at Dinhata College actively organizes seminars, skill development workshops, and occasional campus recruitment drives. While primarily a general degree college, it assists students in securing entry-level roles in banking, finance, and IT sectors through off-campus and on-campus initiatives.

scholarships.name: Swami Vivekananda Merit Cum Means Scholarship (SVMCM)
scholarships.eligibility: Minimum 60% marks in 10+2, family income below ₹2.5 Lakhs

scholarships.name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
scholarships.eligibility: Unmarried female students turning 18 years of age

admission.admissionProcess: Admission to all undergraduate courses is conducted strictly on a merit basis through the centralized online portal according to the guidelines of the Higher Education Department, Govt. of West Bengal, and Cooch Behar Panchanan Barma University. Applicants must submit their academic details online, after which a merit list is generated based on 10+2 board marks.

steps.title: Online Registration
steps.desc: Fill out the online application form with personal and academic details on the admission portal.

steps.title: Document Upload
steps.desc: Upload scanned copies of marksheet, age proof, caste certificate (if applicable), photo, and signature.

steps.title: Merit List Publication
steps.desc: Check the official college website for the category-wise merit list publication.

steps.title: E-Counseling & Admission
steps.desc: Pay the admission fee online through the payment gateway (UPI/Cards) to confirm the seat.

admission.admissionProcess: Admissions to Class 11 are conducted based on the marks obtained in the Madhyamik (Class 10) examination. Forms are distributed at the school office immediately after the publication of the Class 10 board results. A merit list is subsequently published on the school notice board for respective streams.

steps.title: Form Collection
steps.desc: Collect the physical admission form from the school office by showing the Class 10 marksheet.

steps.title: Form Submission
steps.desc: Submit the duly filled form along with photocopies of the marksheet, admit card, and caste certificate (if applicable).

steps.title: Merit List Publication
steps.desc: Check the school notice board for the stream-wise merit list.

steps.title: Final Admission
steps.desc: Pay the admission fees at the school counter on the designated date to secure the seat.
